water_depth_m.qualification: scenario assumption; depth equals supported length

assumptions.locator: Public repository numerical scenario inputs; not measured pipe or hull response data.

defaults.locator: ProjectInputSpec and builders; numerical preparation defaults, not qualified design data.

friction.locator: Yan, White and Randolph (2014), Cyclic consolidation and axial friction for seabed pipelines; Results, p. 166: initial factor 0.32; drained limit tan(phi), Table 1 angle 23.5 degrees. Fully rough modified Cam clay; not a site-wide soil bound.

pull-paper.locator: Krioni, Semenova and Kireev (2018), The algorithm for determining the pulling force while dragging a pipeline, pp. 38-39, equations (5)-(6) and force summation. Channel/HDD context; not transferred as a surface pull-in validation.

unit-conversion.locator: Pipe OD conversion from inch to m, line 195; metre-per-inch factor also used at line 199.
